DialogueRecords.Text: Welcome to inside the angel Gabriel! Everything you see before you is an illusion, so tread lightly.
Your objective awaits on the floors below, so continue this way and look for the doorway.
Although you currently cannot equip items in this version of the game, keep an eye out for treasure chests in future revisions!
Good job, you're heading in the right direction! The doorway is just ahead and is marked on your minimap with a stairs icon.
Be aware that danger lurks below on the next floor.
There's nothing over here. Just a dead end! Use your minimap to help get oriented and head towards the north.

Gabriel: Welcome, children! I see that you have all brought me your Cosmo Engines, and I am pleased to announce that in exchange you will be granted eternal subservience to our master. May I presume this is acceptable?
Proxy: I think there's been some kind of misunderstanding.
Gabriel: Such insolence! How dare you reject our generous offer!
Gabriel: Such insolence! How dare you reject our generous offer!
Gabriel: Your words say 'yes' but your posture indicates otherwise... are you being insincere? This is unacceptable!
Great job in that boss fight! That's all the game content available for now - thank you so much for playing!
